narrative.overview:
The whole site is one staff badge hanging from a lanyard. The page is a graphite ground; a single dark printed-PVC card, one step lighter than the ground, hangs from a steel clip on a slate woven strap printed in teal, and the back of the site is the reverse of that card, a second sheet of the same PVC rising from the bottom with rounded top corners. Four access-zone bands (light ink, teal, muted gold, slate) are the only spot colours; everything else is light ink on graphite or light ink on PVC. The mood is calm and enterprise: dark, low-chroma, with one teal voice.

Hierarchy comes from one condensed face pushed through weight and tracking: tight, heavy, near-solid display lines against wide-tracked uppercase labels, the way a badge printer sets a name over a job title. States are drawn in line, not hue: a double rule on hover, a dashed punch outline on focus and disabled, a solid rule when current. Motion is physical and rare: the badge swings once from its clip and settles, and the foil strip catches light under the pointer.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite ground (color-scheme: dark); light ink and dark PVC carry everything else, teal is the one accent.
One printed card object with real material cues: punched slot, steel clip, soft hanging shadow, foil strip, barcode.
One condensed variable face, two size families (display, text), ranked by weight 450 to 850 and tracking -0.02em to 0.3em.
Line-form states only; colour never signals state alone.

rules.name: The Four Zones Rule
rules.body: Light ink, teal, gold and slate belong to the four access zones and nothing else. Each zone keeps its colour wherever it appears (band on the badge, tag on the back).

rules.name: The Drenched Ground Rule
rules.body: Graphite is the field the badge hangs in, and dark PVC is the only lift above it. Text on graphite or PVC is light ink or faded ink; text on the light surfaces (teal accent, gold zone) is graphite.

rules.name: The One Teal Voice Rule
rules.body: Strap Teal marks the strap, the lanyard, Copy email, selection and caret. It never becomes running text or a content rule, and never signals state by hue; the strap's line-form states simply draw in its teal.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Type lives at display scale or text scale (1.0625rem). There is no intermediate headline or title step; rank inside a size family is by weight and tracking.

rules.name: The Tight-Over-Wide Rule
rules.body: Display lines set tight (negative tracking, sub-1 line-height); labels set wide (0.06em and up, uppercase). Never mix the two on one line.

rules.name: The One Card Rule
rules.body: Only the badge casts a shadow. Content blocks are ruled, never carded.

dos: **Do** signal link, strap and zone state with line form: double rule on hover, dashed outline on focus and disabled, solid rule when current. Filled buttons hover by inverting fill and text.
**Do** keep text at display scale or 1.0625rem and rank by weight (450–850) and tracking.
**Do** keep each zone colour bound to its zone, wherever the zone appears.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion off switch.
**Do** build lists as ruled rows (2px light-ink top rule, 1px hairlines).
**Do** take every colour from the :root tokens; the theme is dark (color-scheme: dark, theme-color graphite).
donts: **Don't** add a second reflective or gradient surface; the foil strip is the only one.
**Don't** add a second shadowed object; only the badge hangs.
**Don't** signal hover, focus or current by a hue change alone.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or intermediate heading sizes.
**Don't** use the zone colours for decoration, buttons or status.
**Don't** spend Strap Teal beyond the strap, lanyard, Copy email, selection and caret.
